facts.value: As cities grow, more people are moving from rural areas in search of better jobs, education, and healthcare. This can create new opportunities but also puts a strain on urban infrastructure, leading to housing shortages, traffic congestion, and overburdened public services.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: The internet connects people but can weaken traditional face-to-face interactions, leading to a sense of isolation. Rising online polarization and issues like cyberbullying and misinformation create stress in digital spaces.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: Uneven wealth distribution leads to divides in communities where wealthier neighborhoods enjoy better services, while poorer areas struggle. Gentrification drives up costs, forcing long-time residents out.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: Communities face challenges from climate change like rising sea levels and natural disasters, impacting agriculture and creating food shortages. Pollution presents health problems and barriers to economic growth.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: Globalization blends cultures, creating tension between generations. Some communities work to preserve heritage, while others face resistance to cultural integration and xenophobia.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: Political conflicts and declining trust in government institutions lead to social unrest and divisions. Media influences polarization and can make cooperation difficult.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: Public health crises like the COVID-19 pandemic highlighted vulnerabilities in communities, exposing inequalities and challenges in healthcare access.
